supported_claims: The fixed outcome-free two-family EEG trajectory geometry replicated structurally across the Discovery, Validation, and Confirmation splits of this dataset.
In Discovery participants with joined trial-level P0.2 physiology, none of the three pre-prespecified multimodal tests M1-M3 passed Holm correction.
No M1-M3 test passed the pre-prespecified combined primary-plus-robustness gate required to open held-out physiology.
Therefore Validation and Confirmation physiology remain unopened for this branch, preserving the held-out boundary.
not_supported_claims: Trial-level peripheral physiology has no relation to EEG trajectory geometry in general.
Raw time-resolved autonomic dynamics have been tested; only the prespecified P0.2 trial-level 40-feature representation was tested.
Family 1/2 are pleasure, suffering, valence, liking, emotion, context, stimulus, or causal states.
Specific GSR or HR features are negative or positive biomarkers; parent gates did not license feature-level follow-ups.
Held-out physiology replicated a null result; held-out physiology was intentionally not opened.
The absence of Discovery support proves biological independence between brain and body signals.
